instruction: A cinematic still medium shot captures an indoor scene by a large window overlooking a hazy winter cityscape. On the left, the bearded man in the white dress shirt (R2) stands in profile, holding a red cup and speaking. Opposite him on the right, the woman in the white button-down shirt (R1) stands in profile, holding a brown paper cup and smiling as she listens. The two stand close together, engaged in a friendly conversation. The scene is illuminated by soft, cool daylight filtering through the window, creating a muted color palette.
